description: This header file declares utility functions related to vendor message processing in the 'vendor_message' namespace, including functions to extract bytes from payloads and to parse vendor-specific messages. It also includes relevant headers and handles vendor message context.

methods.name: extract_uint8
methods.description: Extracts an 8-bit unsigned integer from the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: extract_uint16
methods.description: Extracts a 16-bit unsigned integer from the buffer at the specified offset.

methods.name: parse_vendor_message_type
methods.description: Parses vendor-specific TLV messages for each vendor, extracting vendor OUI and TLV data.
